text.K-2: Hi {name}! This is Wilmington, a real town in Ohio. Let's explore!
text.3-5: Hi {name}! Welcome to Wilmington, Ohio. Every building, road and tree here comes from real map data.
text.6-8: Hi {name}. This is a 3D model of Wilmington, Ohio, built from real map data.
text.9-12: Hi {name}. This is a 3D model of Wilmington, Ohio, built from open map data. Footprints are real; heights are exaggerated 3x.

text.K-2: A **data center** is a big building. What do you think is inside?
text.6-8: A **data center** is a large building. What do you think fills most of it?

right.K-2: Yes! It's full of **computers**. They store videos, games and messages.
right.6-8: Right: thousands of **servers** that store and process data for apps and websites.

wrong.K-2: Good guess! It's really full of **computers**. They store videos, games and messages.
wrong.6-8: Not quite: it's mostly **servers** that store and process data for apps and websites.

text.K-2: Let's build one! Drag the **Enterprise** card onto the glowing square.
text.6-8: Build one: drag the **Enterprise** data center onto open land outside town.

doneText.6-8: Placed! That's 80 acres, about 60 football fields.

text.K-2: Computers need **electricity**. How many homes use as much as this data center?
text.6-8: This data center draws **{mw} MW** of power. How many homes use that much electricity in a year?

text.K-2: It's still being built. Drag the **year slider** to 2027 to turn it on!
text.6-8: It's under construction. Move the **year slider** to 2027, when it opens.

right.K-2: Wow, you got it! It uses as much electricity as about **{homes} homes**!
right.6-8: Correct: running all year it uses as much electricity as about **{homes} homes**.

wrong.K-2: Surprise! It uses as much electricity as about **{homes} homes**!
wrong.6-8: You picked {choice}. It's really about **{homes} homes**: {mw} MW all year adds up fast.

steps.text: The numbers panel shows our model's **rough estimate**. It's close to our math but not the same: real data centers don't always run at full power, and cooling uses extra electricity.
Would you want a **data center** in your town?
Name one **good thing** and one **worry** about building it here.
steps.placeholder: One good thing is… One worry is…

steps.text: Great work, {name}! Next time we'll find out where all that electricity comes from.
